results.ask: Who is TJ?
results.reply: DeskTJ is a Filipino-Dutch software engineering leader, teacher, and manager. He leads 15 to 25 engineers and product specialists at Career Team, teaches college-level software engineering to 150 to 300 students a term at Holy Angel University, and has completed one year in the classroom.

results.ask: What did TJ build with grain?

results.ask: How do you work under the hood?
results.reply: DeskThe shared desk uses Qwen 0.5B, downloaded once and run entirely in your browser on your own device through WebGPU. The Builder can use Qwen 1.5B on devices that pass its conservative capability check; other devices keep the 0.5B model. Nothing you type leaves your machine: there is no server behind either path.
